name: DGS 4402
title: Specimen Preparation, Nucleic Acid Isolation and Assessment
description: Practicum experience in specimen preparation for molecular testing, nucleic acid isolation, and nucleic acid quality control assessment.
requirement_description: Students must earn a "C" or better in DGS 4234/W and 4235; open to Diagnostic Genetic Sciences Molecular concentration majors and Diagnostic Genetic Sciences Molecular concentration certificate students.
